```{=html}

<div class="discount-calculator">


<div class="discount-controls-row">

  <div class="discount-control">
    <label for="discount-rate">
      Discount rate:
      <strong><span id="rate-value">3</span>%</strong>
    </label>
    <input type="range" id="discount-rate"
           min="0" max="10" step="1" value="3">
  </div>

  <div class="discount-control">
    <label for="discount-years">
      Years into the future:
      <strong><span id="years-value">30</span></strong>
    </label>
    <input type="range" id="discount-years"
           min="0" max="50" step="5" value="30">
  </div>

</div>


  <div class="discount-result">
    <div>Present Value of Future $1,000</div>
    <strong id="present-value">$411.99</strong>
  </div>

  <div class="discount-bar">
    <div id="pv-bar"></div>
  </div>

  <p class="discount-caption">
    <span id="pv-percent">41.2</span>% of the
    future benefit's value remains in present-value terms.
  </p>

</div>

<style>
.discount-calculator {
  max-width: 850px;
  margin: 1em auto;
  padding: 1em 1.4em;
  border: 1px solid #cccccc;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: 0.85em;
}
.discount-control {
  margin-bottom: 1.1em;
}
.discount-control label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.35em;
}
.discount-control input {
  width: 100%;
  cursor: pointer;
  accent-color: #2563eb;
}
.discount-result {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0.5em;
  margin: 0.7em 0;
}
.discount-result strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 2.2em;
  color: #2563eb;
}
.discount-bar {
  height: 16px;
  background: #dddddd;
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
#pv-bar {
  height: 100%;
  width: 41.2%;
  background: #2563eb;
  transition: width 0.2s ease;
}
.discount-caption {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 0.65em;
  margin-top: 0.5em;
}

.discount-controls-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 40px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.discount-controls-row .discount-control {
  min-width: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.discount-controls-row input[type="range"] {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

@media (max-width: 650px) {
  .discount-controls-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 20px;
  }
}
</style>


<script>
(function () {
  function updateDiscount() {
    const rate = Number(
      document.getElementById("discount-rate").value
    );
    const years = Number(
      document.getElementById("discount-years").value
    );

    const pv = 1000 / Math.pow(1 + rate / 100, years);
    const percent = pv / 10;

    document.getElementById("rate-value").textContent = rate;
    document.getElementById("years-value").textContent = years;
    document.getElementById("present-value").textContent =
      pv.toLocaleString("en-US", {
        style: "currency",
        currency: "USD"
      });
    document.getElementById("pv-percent").textContent =
      percent.toFixed(1);
    document.getElementById("pv-bar").style.width =
      percent + "%";
  }

  const rateInput = document.getElementById("discount-rate");
  const yearsInput = document.getElementById("discount-years");

  if (rateInput && yearsInput) {
    rateInput.addEventListener("input", updateDiscount);
    yearsInput.addEventListener("input", updateDiscount);
    updateDiscount();
  }
})();
</script>

```
